title: Briech message envelope, version 1
description: The outer shape every Briech message shares. Each message schema adds the exact type and the shape of data.

type.description: What is inside data, e.g. detection or asset.state. A receiver ignores types it does not know.

ts.description: When the message was made, UTC.

src.description: Who sent it: a device id, an operator client, or coordinator.
